facts.name_en: Election to the Senate of the Republic of Poland

rules.formula: block voting: each voter could vote for as many candidates as the constituency has seats, and the candidates with the most votes won (from the results)

facts.note: Held on the day of the Sejm election. The portal's workbook for voivodeship 38 lacks two candidates and the valid-ballot counts.
facts.shares_basis: valid ballots (voters had as many votes as seats, so shares add to more than 100%)
